parsed.notes: Leverage ratio is total funded debt/EBITDA and interest coverage is EBITDA/Consolidated Interest Charges, both as defined in the Amended Credit Agreement. The same figures appear in both MD&A and the debt footnote. The Consolidated Leverage Ratio also sets interest margins, but here it is also a covenant.
